covenants.quote: The Receiving Party shall: (a) use the Disclosing Party's Confidential Information only for the Purpose; (b) disclose it only to its employees, directors, professional advisers and subcontractors who need to know it for the Purpose and are bound by written confidentiality obligations no less protective than this Agreement; (c) protect it with at least reasonable care and no less care than it applies to its own confidential information; and (d) promptly notify the Disclosing Party of any unauthorised use or disclosure of which it becomes aware.
